title: A generated standards index shows agents every repository rule
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-16: a skill must describe all standards this repository enforces so agents know them up front.
Outcome: the standards skill carries a generated index (one line per enforced record: id, rule, path scope, the check that enforces it), regenerated by npm run fast, under a 6 kB budget, identical in KRN and every adopted repo through krn adopt; a test fails when a record lacks an index line.
Proof: node --test test/brain/standards-index.test.ts passes; the index line count equals the enforced record count.
Files: .agents/skills/standards/, src/adopt/skill-set.ts, src/brain/standards.ts
